business_scope.primary_industry_name: International Student Placement and Golden Visa Residence Advisory

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing, as amended; Executive Regulations (Justice Ministerial Decree No. 18 of 2003, as amended); Law No. 94 of 2015 on Combating Terrorism; Companies Law No. 159 of 1981; Central Bank of Egypt AML/CFT directives and AMLU (Anti-Money Laundering Unit) operational regulations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each UBO and shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Egyptian Embassy/Consulate in origin country and Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Cairo); no apostille because Egypt is not an Apostille Convention contracting state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police clearance certificate (certified criminal record extract) of each UBO
Notarized power of attorney granting incorporation authority to the Egyptian resident agent or manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public notary in home country and Egyptian notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of certificate of incorporation and good standing of foreign corporate shareholder, if applicable
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the country of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter verifying source of funds of each UBO
Draft Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization not applicable to domestic draft; notarized in Egypt

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory and continuous PEP and sanctions screening against OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Central Bank of Egypt/AMLU published lists, and Egyptian domestic counter-terrorism designations under Law No. 94 of 2015. Enhanced due diligence is required for all politically exposed persons and their immediate family members or close associates; source-of-funds documentation must be obtained and retained for a minimum statutory period under Egyptian AML rules.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Egyptian Commercial Registry one-stop shop (Tawseel) online portal of the Ministry of Trade and Industry
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be set in Arabic script and in a Latin-alphabet transliteration or translation; the Arabic name is authoritative for official records, while the English rendering must match the reserved certificate consistently. Standard Egyptian commercial naming and transliteration rules apply, including consistent rendering of Hamza and Ta Marbuta.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: any token implying government or public-sector affiliation
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant must obtain the written rejection reason, then file an administrative appeal with the Commercial Registry Review Committee within 15 days, attaching name justification and trademark or goodwill evidence; if rejected again, appeal to the Minister of Trade and Industry within 30 days; final judicial recourse lies before the Egyptian Administrative Court (State Council) pursuant to Law No. 13 of 1998.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted for this licensed study-abroad and immigration visa consultancy; the licensing authority and AML/CFT obligations require an operable physical office with client records, staff, signage, and safe storage of escrow or funds transfer documentation. A virtual or mail-forwarding address is insufficient.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High: approximate annual probability of 65-75% for unannounced on-site inspection by the licensing directorate, administrative control authority, and AML supervisory authorities to verify physical presence, books, student contracts, and visa application files.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian Commercial Registry, Ministry of Trade and Industry

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preliminary investment certificate application (GAFI one-stop shop)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for corporate formation legal services

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended (Book Two, Limited Liability Companies, Articles 96-134), read with the Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations, and the Commercial Registration Law No. 34 of 1976
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Investor Services Center (One-Stop Shop), in coordination with the Commercial Registry at the Ministry of Trade and Industry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Association (Aqd al-Sharika) together with the official Incorporation Application (Form GAFI-1) and the Commercial Registry Amendment Extract
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an LLC under Law No. 159 of 1981; the Articles of Association fix the capital, with a default minimum par value of EGP 100 per share. The full subscribed capital may be deposited in a designated escrow account at a commercial bank, evidenced by a Capital Deposit Certificate before final registration. Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 imposes no higher minimum for a service-consultancy LLC wholly or partly owned by non-residents.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED—First Board Meeting of [Company Name]: (1) That the Company hereby accepts the allocation of one hundred subscribed ordinary shares, each of par value EGP 100, divided among the founding shareholders in equal proportion to their executed consent; (2) That the registered office of the Company be fixed in compliance with the lease executed at the address stated in the Articles of Association; (3) That [NAME] be appointed Managing Director, [NAME] be appointed Financial Director, and [NAME] be appointed Secretary, with full power to open and operate escrow and wire-transfer bank accounts; and (4) That the officers be authorized to execute all incorporation, licensing and regulatory filings required for the study-abroad and immigration advisory business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Legal Name Reservation and Entity Type Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop electronic services portal (https://www.gafi.gov.eg) and the Commercial Registry Name Index
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed LLC name via the GAFI electronic form; verify that the name is distinct from existing registered trademarks and company names; confirm the 'Limited Liability Company' suffix compliance; upload authorization letter from the proposed legal representative.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form
Passport or national ID copies of all proposed shareholders
Power of attorney of the applicant signatory
Brief board resolution authorizing the formation
Proof of categorisation as a service consultancy under ISIC 7810
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, resubmit with up to three alternative names; if the name contains restricted terms (e.g., 'Bank' or 'Insurance'), replace with a permissible descriptor and obtain a fresh clearance receipt.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and Signing of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian Notary Public Office (Tawthiq) under the Ministry of Justice or the GAFI legal authentication window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Association in Arabic containing the statutory LLC particulars: name, object, capital, share distribution, management structure, and registered office. Have all founders and witnesses appear before the notary to sign; collect original signature-certified pages after stamping and settlement of notarial and stamp duties.
required_dossiers: Foundation contract draft in Arabic
Valid national ID or passport of each founding shareholder
Criminal record certificate (Fen Tagari) for each proposed director
Residential lease contract or letter of availability for the head office
Statement of capital allocation and share subscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises objections, rectify the contested article within 15 days by a supplemental unanimous resolution of the founders; re-attest only the corrected pages and keep the original notarial seal ledger entry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening the Escrow Capital Account and Obtaining the Capital Deposit Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial bank operating in Egypt, supervised by the Central Bank of Egypt
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary escrow account in the LLC's name using the notarized Articles and the board resolution; deposit the subscribed capital; complete the bank's KYC/AML and Beneficial Ownership attestation; request the Capital Deposit Certificate evidencing the paid-up funds.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association
Board resolution appointing signatories
KYC and AML questionnaires
Beneficial ownership declaration
Source of funds statement for all contributions
Wire transfer instruction to the escrow account
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the source of funds or beneficial ownership, provide notarized bank statements, tax clearance letters, and an AML remediation dossier; escalate to the Central Bank compliance helpline if the account opening is delayed beyond 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Incorporation Filing and Commercial Registry Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investor Services Center (One-Stop Shop) and the local Commercial Registry Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete incorporation set with GAFI; pay the prescribed registration and publication fees; obtain approval of the Articles; simultaneously enter the LLC in the Commercial Registry for the jurisdiction of the registered office; collect the Commercial Registration Extract and the incorporation certificate.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association
Capital Deposit Certificate
Lease contract and verified proof of registered office
GAFI-1 incorporation application
Board resolution electing the first directors
Criminal records and ID copies of directors
Receipts of paid fees and stamp duties
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI queries the office address, submit the audited lease translation and a notarized landlord consent; if a clause is contested, convene a shareholders' extraordinary resolution signed by all founders and resubmit the amended Articles within 10 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, VAT, and Social Insurance Statutory Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) and the National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the Tax Card and a Tax ID number by submitting Form 8 (Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005); register the LLC for VAT under Law No. 67 of 2016 if the annual taxable supply threshold is met; enroll all employees and the managing director in the NOSI social insurance system within 14 days of the Commercial Registry date.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registry extract
Incorporation certificate
Lease contract
Projected income and expense statement for the first fiscal year
Bank account details and capital deposit certificate
National ID or passport of directors and employees
ETA VAT registration form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ETA detects a mismatch in the national ID or lease details, present certified Arabic translations and a corrected lease endorsement; for late NOSI enrollment, pay the minimal penalty and file an abatement request with the NOSI inspection committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Official Gazette Publication and Delivery of Certified Incorporation Package
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry and the Official Gazette (Al-Waqa'i' Al-Misriyya), with GAFI final endorsement
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Arrange publication of the incorporation summary in the Official Gazette; collect the final notarized extracts, the GAFI approval letter, and the certified Arabic/English transactional package; activate the LLC's e-signature tokens for future filings with ETA, GAFI, and the Commercial Registry portal.
required_dossiers: Final Commercial Registry extract
Incorporation certificate
Gazette publication request form
Receipts of registration and publication fees
Board resolution requesting authenticated copies
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If publication is delayed or omitted, request re-publication with priority processing; if the certified package contains transcription errors, obtain a court-ordered rectification from the competent summary court and refile the corrected extract.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Manpower (Private Placement Offices Licensing Department) under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003, in coordination with the Ministry of Higher Education for study-abroad placement supervision and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for visa facilitation compliance
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Private Employment and Study Abroad Placement License (Ijazat Tashghil Maktab al-Istikhdam wa al-Bi'that) issued under the Executive Regulations of Labor Law No. 12 of 2003

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) under Law No. 4 of 1994 as amended by Law No. 9 of 2009
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category A - office-based consultancy and advisory service; only an Environmental Screening and Registration Form is required, with no full Environmental Impact Assessment report
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Decree No. 44 of 2000 for domestic wastewater discharge into municipal sewers; if a backup electricity generator is installed, compliance with air emission limits under Decree No. 900 of 2022 (NOx ≤ 300 mg/Nm³, SOx ≤ 150 mg/Nm³, PM10 ≤ 50 mg/m³); adherence to hazardous waste and electronic waste handling requirements under Decree No. 301 of 2013

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Clearance (Certificate of Fire Suitability) from the Civil Defense Organization of the Ministry of Interior; structural load inspection certificate for the leased office premises; workplace occupational safety and health clearance from the Industrial Safety Administration of the Ministry of Manpower; social insurance enrollment of all staff as a condition for occupancy

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance of the Arab Republic of Egypt; principal official portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg; integrated e-invoicing/e-receipt clearance portal: https://einvoicing.eta.gov.eg.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned Egyptian LLC: (1) submit corporate registration documents (Articles of Incorporation, Commercial Registry extract) and the contract of incorporation to the ETA's Unified Tax Registration facility; (2) file the prescribed tax identification application with certified Arabic translation, board resolution appointing the manager or resident tax representative, a certified copy of the company's commercial license, authorized signatory IDs, and power of attorney; (3) register for the Unified Tax Identification Number (UTIN) and obtain the statutory tax card; (4) undergo ETA review and potential physical inspection of the registered office; (5) after issuance, file for VAT/e-invoicing registration under the same UTIN and obtain the e-invoicing code-signing certificate before commencing taxable activity.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; an Egyptian LLC is a juridical person resident in Egypt by virtue of incorporation under Egyptian law and is subject to corporate income tax on worldwide income under Law No. 91 of 2005, as amended, with non-resident shareholders having no direct pass-through status.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egypt does not operate a US-style check-the-box regime or provide separate hybrid mismatch elections. Statutory elections available to an Egyptian LLC include (a) consolidation of affiliated taxable groups into a single corporate tax return with ETA approval when legally permitted; (b) VAT registration and the small-taxpayer/simplified VAT regime for turnover below statutory thresholds; (c) election to use exemption treatment for qualifying long-term security and participation holdings where Egyptian tax law confers capital-gains/dividend relief; and (d) available tax-loss carryforward utilization elections subject to ETA supervision and Egyptian GAAP accounting records.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended, administered by the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA); the tax applies to supplies of goods and services made taxable in Egypt with input VAT credit and output VAT collection.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VAT registration is mandatory when annual taxable turnover of goods exceeds EGP 500,000 or when annual taxable turnover of services exceeds EGP 250,000; non-resident suppliers of electronic services or digital services to Egyptian consumers may be subject to VAT registration without reference to these thresholds under subsequent ETA directives.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt mandates B2B e-invoicing and B2C e-receipt clearance through the ETA's national fiscal platform. Issuer ERPs must integrate through the ETA's REST/JSON API, authenticate with OAuth/roles, sign XML/JSON invoice files using a private code-signing certificate, transmit each invoice or e-receipt for ETA validation in real time, and obtain an ETA-issued UUID plus QR fiscal stamp before delivering the invoice to the counterparty. The system applies mandatory staged onboarding by annual turnover; all newly registered LLCs must have an active code-signing certificate, a secure digital transaction ledger, and must accept ETA clearance rejection or failure notifications.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available for (a) tangible goods physically exported outside Egypt under a valid customs export declaration showing the Egyptian exporter as the legal consignor; and (b) services supplied to a non-resident client and consumed entirely outside Egypt, including offshore immigration and study-abroad consultancy services when the benefit is realized abroad. The claim requires a complete documentary trail evidencing performance abroad, foreign recipient status, and receipt of export consideration in convertible foreign currency into an Egyptian licensed bank account.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (final clearing copy approved by Egyptian Customs Authority, including container/vessel identifiers and invoice/EDIFACT reference)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing the definitive movement of goods outside Egyptian territory
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by an Egyptian licensed bank confirming collection of the export proceeds in foreign currency
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA, with the Egyptian Customs Authority, audits zero-rated export claims under strict evidentiary standards. Any missing, forged, or inconsistent export documentation causes immediate reversal of zero-rating, reassessment of VAT at 14%, collection of late-interest and delay penalties, and reversal of claimed input VAT credits. Fraudulent zero-rating or deliberate document falsification exposes the LLC to monetary penalties of no less than EGP 20,000 and up to double the recovered tax amount, disqualification from future e-invoicing clearance privileges, and criminal liability including imprisonment for tax evasion and forgery; foreign-owned LLCs also risk cross-border escalation and banking restrictions under Central Bank of Egypt regulations.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), acting in coordination with the Ministry of Finance as the unified foreign-exchange administrator under Banking Law No. 194/2020 and CBE FX circulars.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Egyptian pound (EGP) is generally convertible for current-account transactions such as profit repatriation, visa/immigration service fees, and trade payments, subject to documentary verification and licensed-dealer settlement. Capital-account remittances, direct foreign investment entry/exit, and cross-border financing require CBE registration, licensed-bank intermediation, and source-of-funds justification. Dividend/profit remittance by a non-resident parent of an Egyptian LLC is permitted after audited financial statements, corporate tax clearance and CBE-approved dealer conversion; no pre-clearance fee is charged, but FX liquidity, bank capacity and anti-money laundering checks can delay settlement. The unified official rate environment reduces the premium of parallel-market conversion but maintains tight purpose-code and negative list controls.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under CBE FX regulations applicable to exporters (including entities with mixed services/exports), export receipts must be repatriated through an authorized bank within 180 days from the bill-of-lading/date of shipment and at least 50% of the foreign-currency export proceeds must be surrendered/converted into EGP at the official bank rate unless a CBE sectoral exemption is granted. For services falling under ISIC 7810, fees for study-abroad and immigration-consulting services are treated as service exports and must be evidenced by a service contract and invoice; receipt is required no later than 180 days after invoice date, with a mandatory 50% conversion in the absence of a CBE waiver. Documents supporting the transaction must be retained for five years.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability for purely offshore EMI entities. The CBE restricts deposit-taking and foreign-currency execution to licensed banks; non-bank EMI or payment-facilitator arrangements require a CBE one-stop authorization for payment services and are severely constrained for inward-direct-investment or escrow purposes. Subject to legal-structure review, an offshore EMI can serve as an ancillary payment rails connector for expense disbursements but cannot act as the primary treasury/escrow depository for Egyptian LLC capital or dividends.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally required for the ultimate beneficial owners and authorized signatories of an Egyptian LLC at the selected bank's branch for account activation, signature verification and enhanced due diligence. Remote opening is occasionally permitted for a corporate account only after a CBE-licensed e-knowledge-based KYC solution has been approved; however, from a practical AML standpoint, the bank will require at least one physical board-level appearance by a director/UBO to complete the interview. Arabic powers of attorney and passport copies are insufficient to waive the interview at most tier-1 banks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity or inconsistent corporate ownership records.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: CBE-compliant ultimate beneficial ownership register, corporate structure chain chart, audited financial statements, notarized board resolution, commercial registry extract, and tax registration certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High geographic risk due to sanctioned or high-risk client nationals among applicant/visa-beneficiary remittances.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanction screening evidence from licensed provider, enhanced due diligence questionnaire, travel/visa-file ledger, source-of-funds declarations and client-risk rating policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Irregular escrow inflows with rapid-out or match-funding patterns on study-abroad fee accounts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Escrow Sub-Ledger Policy, written client engagement contracts, invoice/payment-matching schedules, AML transaction-monitoring escalations, and independent escrow agent attestation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unlicensed immigration advisory activity suspected under Egyptian licensing regimes.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid Ministry-level license/permit portfolio (seller-of-record authorization, labor/social-security certificates), statutory records showing regulatory supervision, and a licensing mapping opinion prepared by a Cairo law firm.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity and shareholder loans from the non-resident parent must be routed through an authorized CBE-licensed bank using an Egyptian Foreign Direct Investment Inward Transfer notification and a clear purpose code (e.g., equity capital/1100 or investor loan/2110). The bank must receive the CBE FDI declaration, board resolution, shareholder distribution schedule, anti-money laundering source-of-funds documentation and legal-entity proof before conversion into EGP. Wire details must identify the Egyptian LLC as ultimate beneficiary and be posted to a designated local EGP capital escrow sub-account; a zero amount should not be left unmatched.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements to overseas universities, visa processing bodies, emigration agents and insurance counterparties should be executed via SWIFT MT103 cover transfers or MT202 for cover, backed by Commercial Letters of Credit where payable against documents. Clearing must be balanced against the service contract, invoice, proof-of-business-purpose and applicable CBE negative list. Payments for education/visa services should use the applicable service-purpose code and will be scrutinized for round-tripping; disbursements cannot exceed the available cleared foreign-currency position.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: CBE-approved deliverable Egyptian pound forwards against USD with licensed local banks on the official rate
Cross-currency interest rate swaps for matched dual-currency finance where permitted
FX swaps and roll-overs for surplus EGP liquidity positions with CBE-authorized dealers

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) prohibited in the onshore wholesale market, but offshore parallel protection may be considered only through non-CBE-licensed dealers outside Egypt (with no onshore enforceability)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Form No. 8) with audited financial statements and tax reconciliation schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - electronic tax filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months of the fiscal year-end; a calendar-year LLC must file by April 30, with an ETA-approved extension option to June 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative late-filing fine of up to EGP 10,000 plus a monthly surcharge of 2% (or any part of a month) on the unpaid tax; continued non-compliance triggers enforced assessment, attachment/lien proceedings and criminal liability for tax evasion.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Registry renewal (annual re-registration of the LLC record)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Trade and Industry - Commercial Registration Authority / GAFI one-stop shop (electronic renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: During the statutory renewal window of January 1 - February 28 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal attracts a fine of 10% of the annual registration fee plus a monthly delay fine; failure to renew for two consecutive cycles leads to administrative strike-off from the Commercial Register and loss of standing to execute contracts or operate bank accounts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial owner (UBO) confirmation and AML register update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI Companies Registry, the Egyptian Financial Intelligence Unit (EMLCU/FIU) and the LLC's internal Beneficial Owner Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed with the annual Commercial Registry renewal (January-February); any shareholding or control change must be reported within 30 days of such change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of up to EGP 500,000 and temporary suspension of registry/amendment services for non-confirmation; deliberate concealment is punishable under AML Law 80 of 2002 with fines up to EGP 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual economic activity and establishment license renewal (study-abroad and immigration-visa consulting operation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local District (Hay) Economic Licensing Office and the relevant sectoral education/immigration licensing inspectorate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the license anniversary; the standard calendar-year renewal window is January 1 - January 31
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Renewal surcharge of 5% per month of delay; non-renewal for 90 days results in license strike-off, administrative closure of the establishment and prohibition of new client contract execution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual salary/personal income tax reconciliation statement and final withholding-tax settlement (annual PAYET return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority - salary and withholding tax department (electronic filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days after the end of the calendar year (by March 1), subject to ETA portal extensions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of EGP 2,000 plus a monthly 2% surcharge on unreported withheld tax; directors are jointly and severally liable for withheld amounts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Social Insurance wage list and contribution declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI / NIO) - electronic submission portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual wage list submitted by the end of February following the calendar year; monthly contribution declarations are due by the 10th day of the following month
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly interest of 2% on contribution arrears plus administrative fines for omitted wage lists; prolonged evasion results in forced collection proceedings and criminal sanctions against the company managers.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All limited liability companies must appoint at least one licensed financial auditor. Under Companies Law 159 of 1981, statutory audit is mandatory where paid-up capital exceeds EGP 50,000; under the new Companies Law 277 of 2024, regulated-services LLCs (study-abroad and immigration-visa advisory) are subject to annual independent audit in all cases, and the AML/CFT regime additionally requires an external audit opinion on customer-money (escrow) controls.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) as locally adopted and aligned with IFRS by the Ministry of Finance and the Financial Regulatory Authority; the audited financial statements must be prepared in Egyptian pounds, with statutory notes in Arabic or bilingual form.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: At each annual Commercial Registry renewal (January-February), the LLC must electronically confirm its beneficial owners, including every natural person holding more than 25% of the equity or control; any transfer of quotas or change in directorship must be reported to GAFI within 30 days, authenticated by notarization where applicable, and the internal Beneficial Owner Register updated contemporaneously.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors/Managers and their resolutions
Minute Book of general assemblies or single-member decisions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400-800 per year for a professional registered-office/business-services address and corporate representative in Cairo or Giza, including handling of official correspondence and registry follow-up
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200-2,500 per year for a certified audit of a small or medium services LLC, varying with transaction volume, escrow movement and the number of immigration/visa case files

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% on net taxable income of juridical persons under Article 47 of Law No. 91 of 2005 as amended by Law No. 30 of 2023.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No blanket national income tax holiday; qualified Free Zone and Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) projects may enjoy 0%-10% effective rates or a 50% reduction for up to five years; taxpayers with annual revenue below the SME thresholds of Law No. 152 of 2020 may elect simplified presumptive turnover taxation of 0.5%-1.5% in lieu of accounting-based CIT.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Return, Form No. 1 (CIT), submitted through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) electronic filing portal at www.eta.gov.eg and the ETA e-tax platform; mandatory e-invoice and e-receipt integration applies to all B2B and B2C transactions of the immigration and study-abroad consultancy.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual return; four quarterly advance CIT instalments are filed and paid within 30 days after each calendar quarter based on the prior-year assessed tax, with a final reconciliation at the annual deadline.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing and final payment are due within four months after the close of the fiscal year (e.g., by 30 April for a 31 December year-end); the fiscal year may follow the company's Articles of Association subject to ETA approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax Identification Number (TIN) and ETA Tax Card Number registered in the name of the Limited Liability Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident company operating through a branch or permanent establishment must obtain an Egyptian TIN before filing; otherwise the return is rejected.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal form, Commercial Register number, incorporation date, and registered office address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the GAFI branch registration certificate for any non-resident parent or branch; a foreign entity with no Egyptian PE need not file this return for Egyptian-source fees subject to final withholding.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income from study-abroad placement, immigration visa consulting, escrow administration, and ancillary service fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All Egypt-source fees, including escrow releases and wire-transferred client onboarding payments, must be aggregated; currency translation follows the Central Bank of Egypt exchange rate at the accrual date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible direct costs: visa processing fees, university liaison costs, licensed consultant salaries, rent, technology subscriptions, and bank charges paid through the corporate bank account.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions require full documentation (contracts, invoices, bank transfers); no deduction is allowed for fines, undocumented donations, or payments failing ETA withholding or e-invoicing rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net profit before depreciation, amortization, and loss carryforward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Costs invoiced by a foreign parent or sister company must be substantiated by an arm's length transfer pricing file; otherwise the ETA will disallow the excess.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax loss carried forward from prior years, limited to five consecutive fiscal years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses are forfeited upon a 50% or greater ownership change unless the transaction is approved in advance by the ETA; non-resident shareholders should maintain the sale-and-purchase records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable base after deductions and loss offset, together with the applicable statutory rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The standard rate is 22.5%; a non-resident branch must apply the same rate to Egyptian-source business profits attributable to its PE and cannot use consolidated foreign losses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total income tax assessed, credit for quarterly instalments, and net tax payable or refund claimed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach ETA withholding certificates for any Egyptian-source interest, royalty, or service payments already subjected to final withholding; treaty relief must be evidenced by an ETA authorization letter and valid Tax Residence Certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Related-party transaction schedule and TP Disclosure Form (annex) covering controlled transactions with the parent, affiliated agencies, and overseas university partners.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Complete this section only if the aggregate annual controlled transaction value exceeds EGP 15 million; a non-resident group must attach the Local File and, where applicable, the Master File benchmarks.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Special deduction or exemption schedule for Free Zone or Special Economic Zone licensed income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident-owned LLC holding a Free Zone or SCZONE license must demonstrate export ratio compliance and the 10% distribution tax treatment applicable to any profits remitted out of exempt income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment carries a monthly surcharge of 2% of the unpaid tax, capped at 90% of the assessed tax, plus administrative fines; late filing is punished by a fixed fine ranging from EGP 50,000 to EGP 500,000 under Tax Procedure Law No. 206 of 2020, in addition to the monthly surcharge; deliberate non-filing constitutes tax evasion under Law No. 91 of 2005 and is prosecuted criminally.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% domestic withholding tax on dividends because Egyptian resident companies distribute already-taxed profits under the classical exemption in Article 44 of Law No. 91 of 2005; however, distributions made out of tax-exempt Free Zone profits are subject to a 10% tax levied on the distributing company, creating an effective 10% withholding-equivalent cost on the repatriated dividend.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a reduced or zero dividend, interest, or royalty rate under an Egyptian double tax treaty, the non-resident recipient must (i) obtain a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) issued by its home tax authority for the relevant calendar year, (ii) file an ETA Treaty Relief Application containing the TRC, the underlying agreement, an ownership and beneficial ownership declaration, and certified minutes of the Egyptian paying LLC, (iii) obtain ETA approval in advance of the payment date, and (iv) transmit the approval to the Egyptian withholding agent; the ETA may deny or claw back relief where beneficial ownership or economic substance is absent.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory WHT is 20% on gross interest, royalties, and certain technical or management service fees paid to non-residents without an Egyptian PE (Article 56 of Law No. 91 of 2005); treaty-protected rates commonly range from 10% to 20% for interest and 10% to 20% for royalties, with typical outcomes of 15% for interest and 12% for royalties; the reduced rate applies only after the ETA treaty-relief file is approved or through a subsequent refund claim.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 15 million aggregate annual controlled transaction value triggers mandatory preparation and filing of the TP Disclosure Form annexed to Form No. 1 and the Local File; a Master File is required where the Egyptian LLC is controlled by a non-resident group whose consolidated revenue exceeds the ETA threshold, currently aligned with the OECD Country-by-Country Reporting de minimis of EUR 750 million equivalent.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not apply the GCC-style Economic Substance Regulations; instead, the general anti-avoidance rule in Article 90 of Law No. 91 of 2005 and Tax Procedure Law No. 206 of 2020 allow the ETA to disregard artificial arrangements lacking commercial purpose and beneficial ownership. The study-abroad and golden-visa consultancy must demonstrate substantive presence through licensed immigration consultants on payroll, a physical registered office, executed client contracts, escrow records, and economic control over its revenue, otherwise the company may be treated as a shell, expenses disallowed, and treaty benefits denied.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving study-abroad and visa-consulting fees in cash or through hidden escrow accounts without recording revenue, creating forged expense invoices, or submitting a Form No. 1 return that omits Egypt-source transaction fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment up to five years and a fine equal to two to five times the evaded tax under Articles 112-113 of Law No. 91 of 2005; the ETA also imposes the monthly surcharge up to 90% of the tax under Law No. 206 of 2020, and GAFI may revoke the commercial registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the designated tax signatory are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax, fines, and surcharges; criminal conviction carries imprisonment, automatic bank attachment, and a travel ban until full restitution.
